description: Na₂MnFeCd(PO₄)₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are two shorter (2.36 Å) and four longer (2.49 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.86 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.92 Å. Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with two PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.45 Å. Fe is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.48 Å. There are two inequivalent Cd sites. In the first Cd site, Cd is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent P and four O atoms. Both Cd-P bond lengths are 2.58 Å. There are two shorter (2.48 Å) and two longer (2.66 Å) Cd-O bond lengths. In the second Cd site, Cd is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent O atoms. Both Cd-O bond lengths are 2.10 Å. There are four inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.48-1.51 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 43°. There are two shorter (1.55 Å) and two longer (1.57 Å) P-O bond lengths. In the third P site, P is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Cd and three O atoms. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.69 Å. In the fourth P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 50°. There are two shorter (1.51 Å) and two longer (1.62 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Na and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one O atom. The O-O bond length is 1.44 Å. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, one Cd, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, one Cd, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mn, and one P atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₂MnP trigonal pyramids. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two P atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Fe, and one O atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two Na and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Mn, one Fe, and one Cd atom.
